basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is hiring one Project Research Associate - Research for the research project "Hussh One Reference Implementation: Personal Consent Handshake Protocol (PHP) with Finance and Wellness Application Agents", sponsored by Hushh Technologies Corporation. The consolidated compensation is up to 60000 per month for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Applications are online, and the last date is 19 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum. Mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

how_to_apply: Apply online for the assignment advertised under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/OWA/2026/102. The notice does not print the web address of the application form.
Submit the application on or before 19 November 2026.

The notice lists the application fee as Rs. 0 for all categories. Where an amount is deposited, it goes by RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc. to State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302. The account name is IIT SRIC-OM Account, account no. 39502115210, IFSC code SBIN0000202, SWIFT code SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Associate - Research at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process in detail or the job location.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy)
Hussh One Reference Implementation: Personal Consent Handshake Protocol (PHP) with Finance and Wellness Application Agents (Project Code – R/OWA)
Hushh Technologies Corporation (1021 5th Street W, Kirkland, Washington 98033, United States of America)
12 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to 60000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists three alternative essential qualifications for the Project Research Associate - Research post. M.Tech / ME / MDes / MD or equivalent degree; OR B.Tech / BE / MBBS / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree with 2 years relevant experience; OR B.Sc. / B.A. / B.Com or equivalent degree with 5 years relevant experience. B.E./B. Tech with a valid GATE score in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE is strongly desirable. M.Tech / ME in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE will be preferred. CGPA must be >=7.50. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum. Mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to 60000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary and tied to the project. It lasts 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier. The notice states that this project position provides an opportunity to pursue a PhD in CSE.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview. It says that meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. The interview date and the method of shortlisting are not specified in the notice.
